left.title: Turn it into something new
left.body: Quick ways to use this up before it goes off.
left.reheat: Heat it until it is steaming hot all the way through, and only once.
left.riceCare: Cooked rice: keep it in the fridge and eat it within a day. Don't leave it out on the counter.
left.idea.dalParatha.b: Knead the dal into atta with a little salt and ajwain, then roll and cook like any paratha.
left.idea.dalChilla.b: Mix thick dal with besan, chopped onion and chilli into a batter and make thin chillas on the tawa.
left.idea.dalTadka.b: Thin it with a little hot water, boil, and pour over a fresh tadka of ghee, jeera and garlic.
left.idea.rajmaWrap.b: Mash it a little, spread on a roti with onion and green chutney, and roll it up.
left.idea.rajmaTikki.b: Drain, mash with a boiled potato and some poha or bread, shape into tikkis and shallow fry.
left.idea.lemonRice.b: Tadka of mustard seeds, curry leaves, peanuts and haldi; toss the rice in it and squeeze in lemon.
left.idea.curdRice.b: Warm the rice, cool it, mix in curd and salt, and top with a tadka of rai and curry leaves.
left.idea.friedRice.b: Stir-fry onion, capsicum and any vegetables on high heat, add the rice, salt and pepper.
left.idea.khichdiTikki.b: Mix with besan, onion and coriander, shape into small tikkis and cook on the tawa until crisp.
left.idea.khichdiParatha.b: Knead the khichdi into atta, roll and cook. Good with curd and pickle.
left.idea.rotiNoodles.b: Cut the rotis into thin strips and toss with onion, capsicum, a little sauce and chilli.
left.idea.rotiChuri.b: Crumble warm rotis with ghee and jaggery. A quick sweet for after a meal.
left.idea.stuffedParatha.b: Mash the sabzi, fill it into rolled atta, seal and roll again, then cook with a little ghee.
left.idea.toastie.b: Spread it between two slices of bread with a little butter and toast on the tawa.
left.idea.curryWrap.b: Cook it down until thick, wrap in a roti or paratha with onion rings and a squeeze of lemon.
left.idea.curryPulao.b: Layer it with fresh hot rice, cover and keep on low heat for five minutes.
left.idea.kadhiChawal.b: Heat it with a splash of water, stirring so it doesn't split, and serve over fresh rice.
left.idea.kadhiPakora.b: Fry a few fresh onion pakoras and drop them in just before eating.
left.idea.pohaCutlet.b: Mash with a boiled potato, shape into cutlets and shallow fry until golden.
left.idea.anyWrap.b: Warm it up, wrap it in a roti with onion and chutney, and it's a meal.

swaps.title: Make it different
swaps.twistHow.shahi: Grind nuts to a smooth paste and stir them into the gravy with milk or cream at the end. Rich, mild, a little sweet.
swaps.twistHow.kofta: Mash the main vegetable with a little besan and salt, shape small balls, shallow-fry or air-fry, and drop them in the gravy just before serving.
swaps.twistHow.tikka: Coat pieces in thick curd, besan and the dish's masalas, rest 20 minutes, then roast on a hot tawa or in the air fryer until charred at the edges.
swaps.twistHow.dum: Add whisked curd, cover tightly and cook on the lowest flame for 10 minutes so the masala soaks in.
cook.basicsBody: Dough for roti, paratha, puri, bhatura and kulcha, rice and dal, and Sunday batches (onion-tomato masala, boiled chana) that make weekday cooking quicker. 1 katori atta makes about 4 rotis.

guests.none: Add a few things to your kitchen and I'll plan a menu.
tiffin.title: Tomorrow's tiffin
tiffin.idea.dal_paratha: Cook one portion extra: knead the leftover dal into atta for dal parathas tomorrow.
tiffin.idea.rajma_rice: Cook one portion extra: rajma rice packs well for tomorrow's tiffin.
tiffin.idea.aloo_roll: Cook one portion extra: roll it in a paratha for tomorrow's tiffin.
tiffin.idea.paneer_roll: Cook one portion extra: cook it down until dry and roll it in a roti tomorrow.
tiffin.idea.chicken_roll: Cook one portion extra: shred the chicken and roll it in a paratha tomorrow. Reheat until steaming hot.
tiffin.idea.khichdi_cutlet: Cook one portion extra: shape the cold khichdi into cutlets and shallow-fry them tomorrow.
tiffin.idea.kadhi_rice: Cook one portion extra: kadhi with rice is a good tiffin. Pack the pakoras separately so they stay crisp.
tiffin.fridge: Cool the extra and keep it in the fridge overnight.
